summary: Lane 40 (business logic) on http://shop.lab.test. HTTPS refused connections, so all testing used http. Items 1, 2, 3, 5, 6 and 7 are marked done with evidence. Main finding: GET /api/v1/checkout/quote accepts a client-supplied price, returning totals of 0.01, 0 and -5 EUR against a list price of 89.90 with status "ready to pay", and it ignores qty. This is recorded as a high lead; whether an order would be charged at that price is unverified because writes are disallowed. Also recorded: the cart check treats qty=6 (max 5 per order) and qty=-2 as valid, and the register and login forms have no anti-forgery token. Left open: item 4 (process timing), which needs timing or race tests that depend on state-changing requests, and items 8 and 9 (upload), because no upload feature is visible unauthenticated, the account area needs sign-in, no test accounts are provided, and uploads are POSTs that writes forbid. Not used: no order was placed, no login or forgot-password was attempted, and no brute-force or load traffic was sent. The forgot-password lead (idnt lane) was not re-probed because its GET sends a reset email.
